Design and draft optimal fiber routes by performing feasibility analysis while considering cost, constructability, quality, and timelines. Develop cost-effective engineering designs within customer systems and construction budgets. Take constructive feedback from QCs/Leads and continuously improve quality and efficiency. For senior/expert positions, serve as a Technical SME/POC , providing mentoring, technical guidance, and knowledge transfer to team members. Support team members in improving productivity, technical capability, and design quality. Take ownership of assigned deliverables and support initiation and closure of new scopes of work. Contribute ideas toward automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement . Actively participate in training and feedback sessions and apply learning to project delivery. Be flexible to work across teams/projects and take on additional responsibilities based on business requirements. Tools & Technologies Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: ARAMIS | IQGeo | WALDO | QGIS | ArcGIS | 3GIS | CGIS | SpatialNET | COMSof | NDS | FROGS | AutoCAD | FMS | O-Calc | Smallworld | Netwin | WebGIS All you need is... Relevant experience in ASE, F1/F3, F2, Greenfield/DFIB or similar fiber network scopes. AT&T project experience is preferred. Demonstrates strong knowledge and hands-on experience in copper working Pairs, LST/Throw, Research, PRQ jobs, Copper Relocation/Removal/Replacement, and Copper Reclaim activities. B.Tech in any Engineering or equivalent Relevant OSP/Fiber Design, GIS, AutoCAD, or telecom certifications will be an added advantage. Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Lead Algorithm Developer to drive the design, development, and production deployment of advanced 3D image reconstruction algorithms for next-generation X-ray inspection, metrology, and computational imaging systems. The role combines deep technical expertise, architectural ownership, hands-on algorithm development, and technical leadership to deliver high-fidelity volumetric reconstruction with strong accuracy, throughput, and robustness. Key Responsibilities · Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and optimization of 3D reconstruction algorithms from concept through production deployment. · Develop and improve tomographic reconstruction techniques for CT, XCT, and cone-beam CT, including analytical, iterative, model-based, and AI-assisted methods. · Build algorithms for projection preprocessing, calibration, denoising, artifact correction, reconstruction, registration, segmentation, and volumetric analysis. · Combine physics-based modeling, inverse-problem optimization, computer vision, and deep learning to improve reconstruction quality and system performance. · Optimize large-scale 3D reconstruction pipelines for GPU, multithreaded, and high-performance computing environments. · Define validation methodology and quality metrics using simulation, laboratory, and production datasets. · Collaborate with systems, hardware, software, applications, and product teams to translate customer needs into scalable algorithmic solutions. · Mentor algorithm engineers, conduct technical reviews, establish engineering best practices, and contribute to the technology roadmap. · Drive innovation through prototypes, patents, publications, and differentiated production capabilities. Education & Experience Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline; a bachelor's degree with substantial relevant industry experience may also be considered. · 8+ years of experience in algorithm development, computational imaging, image processing, computer vision, or a related technical field. · At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing 3D image reconstruction or tomographic imaging algorithms. · Proven experience delivering production-quality reconstruction algorithms for X-ray CT/XCT, cone-beam CT, microscopy, medical imaging, industrial inspection, or semiconductor metrology systems. · Demonstrated ability to transition research prototypes into maintainable, testable, and performance-optimized production software. Required Skills Hands-on expertise with analytical and iterative reconstruction techniques such as filtered back projection, Feldkamp-Davis-Kress, ART, SART/SIRT, and model-based iterative reconstruction. · Experience solving inverse imaging problems using numerical optimization, regularization, statistical estimation, compressed sensing, or Bayesian methods. · Experience with projection-domain and image-domain corrections including detector calibration, denoising, ring and streak artifact reduction, beam-hardening correction, and motion or alignment compensation. · Experience with large volumetric datasets, 3D registration, segmentation, feature extraction, defect analysis, and quantitative metrology. · Strong programming skills in C++ and Python; MATLAB or equivalent scientific prototyping tools are beneficial. · Experience with CUDA/GPU computing, parallel processing, multithreading, or high-performance computing. · Strong foundation in linear algebra, numerical methods, optimization, probability, statistics, signal processing, imaging physics, and 3D geometry. · Experience with NumPy, SciPy, OpenCV, ITK, VTK, CUDA, or equivalent scientific and imaging libraries. Preferred Qualifications Experience with semiconductor inspection, metrology, defect review, or advanced manufacturing systems. · Knowledge of X-ray imaging physics, detector behavior, acquisition geometry, system calibration, and numerical simulation. ·

eightfold:citi:859038611224.description: We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will assist in designing, building, maintaining, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytics infrastructure. You will work closely with senior data engineers, data scientists, software developers, and business stakeholders to transform raw data into structured, actionable data assets for reporting, advanced analytics, and operational systems. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Pipeline Development & Maintenance (ETL / ELT) Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest structured and unstructured data from diverse sources (APIs, relational databases, streaming services, flat files). Monitor existing data pipelines, troubleshoot data ingestion failures, and implement bug fixes or performance enhancements. Implement data transformation, cleansing, and validation routines to maintain high data quality and consistency. 2. Data Modeling & Storage Support the design and maintenance of relational schemas, dimensional models (star and snowflake schemas), and data lake storage structures. Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and views to extract and aggregate data efficiently. Assist in partitioning, indexing, and organizing datasets for optimal query performance. 3. Data Quality & Governance Collaborate with senior engineers to implement data validation checks, monitoring alerts, and data reconciliation processes. Follow enterprise data governance, privacy, and security policies (e.g., role-based access control, encryption, data masking). Document data lineage, metadata definitions, schema changes, and technical architecture. 4. Collaboration & CI/CD Practices Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings. Use version control systems (Git) for code management and follow continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. Collaborate with QA teams and business analysts to conduct integration and user acceptance testing (UAT). Qualifications & Skills Required Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience/bootcamp certification). Experience: 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience in data engineering, data analytics, software development, or related academic/internship projects. Key Skills & Technologies Programming Languages Python, SQL (mandatory); familiarity with Java, Scala, or Bash scripting is a plus. Relational Databases & SQL PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, or Oracle. Proficient in joins, window functions, indexing, and aggregations. Data Warehousing & Lakes Familiarity with platforms such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, Databricks, or cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, GCS). Data Processing Frameworks Basic understanding of Apache Spark, PySpark, Pandas, or Polars. Workflow Orchestration Exposure to tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or cron-based job scheduling. Version Control & DevOps Git/GitHub/GitLab, basic containerization (Docker), and exposure to CI/CD pipelines. Soft Skills & Competencies Problem Solving: Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting mindset with attention to detail. Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to Learn: Self-starter with a proactive attitude toward learning modern data architectures, cloud technologies, and best practices. Teamwork: Strong collaborative skills and ability to thrive in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications Cloud certification (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Data Analytics, Azure Data Fundamentals DP-900 / DP-203, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer). Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as dbt (data build tool) , Kafka, or Delta Lake. Understanding of basic DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes). Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). eightfold:citi:859038766500.description: Job Description: Are you a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer looking to make a significant impact in the dynamic world of finance? Join our cutting-edge technology team and play a pivotal role in developing and enhancing our proprietary “Margin Calculations and Reporting” Platform, a critical component of our Prime Finance Services organization. This is an exceptional opportunity to apply your technical expertise to complex, computing-intensive financial solutions within a collaborative and globally connected environment. This role is at the heart of our Prime Services division, where you will contribute to the evolution of a sophisticated margin calculation engine. This engine leverages a complex model and intricate business logic to provide leverage to clients and reduce risk for Citi, directly impacting our financial operations. As a Software Engineer, you will be instrumental in delivering end-to-end software solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, and robustness for our critical financial systems globally. The Applications Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities. Responsibilities: As a key member of our global development team, you will: Innovate & Develop: Design, develop, and implement robust and scalable application systems and programs for the Margin Calculation Services and reporting, aligning with strategic technology initiatives. Problem Solve: Consult with users, clients, and other technology groups on issues, and recommend programming solutions. Analyze complex technical and business challenges, and propose innovative solutions that enhance system functionality and business processes. Project work: Monitor and guide all phases of the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through construction, testing, and implementation, ensuring timely and high-quality project delivery. Provide user and operational support on applications to business users Strategic Impact: Utilize your expertise in application development to make evaluative judgments, recommend security measures, and contribute to post-implementation analysis, ensuring optimal system design and functionality. Collaboration & Consultation: Partner closely with project managers, business stakeholders, and senior managers to translate complex business requirements into well-architected technical solutions. Consult with users and other technology groups, providing advanced programming insights and support. Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to best practices and essential procedures. Autonomy & Ownership: Operate with a high degree of independence and judgment, taking ownership of critical initiatives and driving them to successful completion. Risk Management: Proactively assess and manage technical risks, demonstrating a strong commitment to regulatory compliance, ethical judgment, and transparent reporting of control issues. Qualifications: 4-5 years of relevant experience in the Financial Service industry Intermediate level experience in Applications Development role Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements Technical Expertise : Strong proficiency in Java application technologies, including deep experience with TDD (Test-Driven Development) , Spring framework , and Microservices architecture . Excellent knowledge of algorithms and data structures, design patterns. Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications Strong Java experience : Java core, collections, concurrency, streams Frameworks and APIs: Spring (Core, Batch, Integration, MVC, Boot, Data), Hibernate, Jackson , JAX RS, JPA, JAXB Experience with distributed caches like Apache Gemfire will be a plus Messaging: JMS, Kafka Testing: JUnit, Mocking frameworks (Mockito, Power Mock) Experience in performance enhancements using parallel processing, multithreading. Understanding locking/synchronization Understanding Docker and Kubernetes Experience in RESTful API development and integration, deployment framework and source control experience such as Git. Solid understanding and experience with SQL . Proficiency in Linux environments. Experience with job scheduling. Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. eightfold:hp:45479580.description: Database Engineering SME, Global Database Administration Description - The Database Engineer SME provides advanced technical expertise for enterprise database architecture, engineering, modernization, security, resiliency, and operational support. This role requires significant hands-on experience with Oracle database technologies, complemented by experience with other relational, cloud-based, and emerging database technologies. The ideal candidate brings a broad understanding of enterprise data platforms and can apply that knowledge across a diverse and evolving database landscape. The position serves as a technical lead and database subject-matter expert supporting application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, operations, and project teams. The Database Architect applies advanced technical knowledge and independent judgment to solve complex problems, develop and improve database standards and practices, support cross-functional initiatives, and provide technical guidance and mentoring to other database professionals. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain enterprise Oracle database architecture, engineering standards, and best practices across on-premises, virtualized, hybrid, and cloud environments. Design secure, highly available, scalable, performant, and recoverable database solutions using Data Guard, Data Guard Broker, and RMAN. Lead database upgrades, migrations, patching, modernization, cloud adoption, infrastructure transformation, and technical-debt reduction initiatives. Establish standards for HA/DR, backup and recovery, performance, monitoring, observability, security, patching, and lifecycle management. Support SOX, ITGC, cybersecurity, privileged access, encryption, auditing, governance, and compliance requirements. Provide expert technical leadership for major incidents, complex troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, performance issues, and database recovery. Drive automation of provisioning, monitoring, patching, maintenance, compliance reporting, backup validation, and lifecycle activities. Evaluate emerging database, cloud, automation, and observability technologies and recommend appropriate solutions. Maintain architecture standards, technical procedures, operational documentation, and technology roadmaps. Mentor database engineers and represent GDBA in architecture reviews, modernization programs, audits, and vendor engagements. Follow ITIL-aligned Change, Incident, Problem, and Configuration Management processes for production database services. Plan and execute database changes through formal Change Management, including risk/impact assessment, implementation plans, validation, rollback procedures, and post-change reviews. Maintain accurate database and infrastructure Configuration Items (CIs) in the CMDB, including ownership, relationships, lifecycle status, and configuration information. Ensure database incidents, problems, changes, and configuration records comply with organizational ITSM, SOX, ITGC, security, and audit requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 12+ years of progressive database administration, engineering, architecture, and enterprise operations experience, including 8+ years of enterprise Oracle experience. Expert knowledge of Oracle Database 19c or later, Data Guard/Data Guard Broker, RMAN, and Oracle Enterprise Manager. Advanced performance tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, wait events, and SQL tuning techniques. Strong experience with Oracle RU/CPU patching, Opatch, upgrades, migrations, consolidation, and lifecycle management. Strong Linux, Perl scripting, Python, Shell scripting, T-SQL, SQL, and PL/SQL administration and automation capabilities. Extensive experience supporting mission-critical production databases, including incident management, RCA, problem management, HA/DR, and recovery. Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and MySQL, plus cloud database services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Amazon RDS. Strong understanding of database security, encryption/TDE, privileged access, audit logging, SOX, ITGC, cybersecurity, and governance controls. Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills within geographically distributed global teams. Extensive experience with Always on Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances (FCI), replication, and log shipping. Strong understanding of ITIL and IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Change Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Configuration Management, and CMDB. Experience working with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, including change requests, incidents, problems, configuration items, and CMDB processes. Experience operating database services within formal change-control, CAB, risk-management, and audit/compliance frameworks. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in relevant technical discipline. Experience with large-scale database modernization, cloud adoption, migrations, consolidation, and infrastructure-transformation programs. Broader knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and distributed/NoSQL technologies. Cloud architecture experience across OCI, Azure, AWS, and hybrid-cloud environments. Automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Shell, Ansible, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD. Relevant Oracle, OCI, Azure, AWS, Linux, architecture, security, or ITSM certifications. Proven ability to mentor DBAs, lead complex technical initiatives, and drive automation, reliability, security, standardization, and operational efficiency. Advanced proficiency in T-SQL, stored procedures, execution plan analysis, and database optimization. Enterprise monitoring tools, AI in enterprise databases. Strong Python scripting and automation skills, including experience developing reusable scripts and integra

eightfold:lam-research:1099556874299.description: The group you’ll be a part of The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes. The impact you’ll make Lead a high-performing, research-driven engineering team developing next-generation autonomous robotic systems that service complex semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Design and develop research roadmaps for current and future robotic capability, champion strategic research directions with senior executive leadership, and drive external innovation through university partnerships, research institutions, and emerging robotics/AI startup engagements. What you’ll do · Manage, mentor, and grow a multidisciplinary team of robotics research engineers across four core areas – perception, mobility, Robotic Manipulation & Dexterity, Physical AI/ML · Lead the research, architecture, and end-to-end prototyping of robotics technologies from initial research concept through functional technology-readiness demonstration · Partner with R&D leadership to set the research direction for current and future robotic requirements · Architect high-precision perception systems using cameras and laser scanners for scene understanding sub-millimetre level end-effector manipulation, install-quality validation, defect inspection and calibration · Lead the selection, integration, and control of advanced force-controlled robotic arms and path planning in partnership with arm OEMs (Flexiv, UR, ABB) · Drive the prototyping of custom and general-purpose end effectors and grippers with force feedback, visual servoing, dexterous hands, and compact tool changers to expand task and application coverage · Lead the development of Automated Mobile Robots (AMR) based mobile manipulation systems - integrating robotic arms onto custom and off-the-shelf AMRs with human-safe autonomous navigation, high-precision automated tool docking. · Pioneer Physical AI, multi-modal sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning models—including imitation/mimic learning, reinforcement learning (RL), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real deployment pipelines · Establish and manage strategic collaborations with leading universities, academic research labs, and 3rd-party partners - eightfold:paypal:274922911270.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: What you need to know about the role As an Android Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the PayPal POS app on Android phones and on Zettle Terminal hardware. You will work on features across the merchant experience, from sign-in and bootstrap to checkout, receipts, refunds and invoices, and learn how the app talks to card readers and terminals. Meet our team Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned. We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions May contribute to code & design reviews Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Your way to impact Make checkout and receipts fast and reliable for merchants at the counter, on phones and on terminals. Deliver features across product library, inventory, purchase history, refunds and invoices. Help legacy Zettle merchants move onto PayPal identity with a smooth sign-in and onboarding experience in the app. Improve app stability, release quality and crash-free sessions across a wide range of devices. Your day to day Build and ship features in Kotlin and Java using Jetpack libraries, coroutines and Jetpack Compose. Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows. Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity and terminal hardware integration under guidance. Write unit and instrumentation tests, and take part in code reviews, CI/CD and staged releases. Investigate crashes and production issues using analytics and monitoring, and fix root causes. Pair with Sweden engineers and write documentation and runbooks for areas you take over. What do you need to bring- 1 to 3 years of Android development experience with strong Kotlin. Hands-on with Jetpack, coroutines, networking and local persistence; Jetpack Compose is a plus. Experience with unit and instrumentation testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps. Understanding of secure handling of sensitive data on device. Interest in payments; experience with Bluetooth peripherals, NFC or POS hardware is a plus. Nice to have: Java, GraphQL clients, device management and app distribution tooling. Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden. A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records. Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product. OR Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. OR PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. This senior-level engineering role focuses on signal integrity ownership for advanced semiconductor packages used in AI accelerators, high-performance computing devices, networking switch ASICs, and data center products. The position spans modeling, simulation, optimization, cross-functional collaboration, and package-to-PCB sign-off for high-speed interconnects. • Advanced package ownership: Responsibilities include analyzing organic substrates, 2.5D interposers, and multi-die packages; modeling bumps, redistribution layers, traces, vias, BGA connections, and package-to-PCB transitions; and optimizing impedance, loss, reflections, and crosstalk. The engineer also supports package floorplanning, bump assignments, ball maps, and substrate stack-updevelopment. • High-speed interface analysis: The role covers 112G and 224G PAM4 SerDes, emerging 448G interfaces, PCIe Gen5 through Gen7, UCIe, DDR5, and LPDDR5X. Work extends from package-only channels to complete die-package-PCB simulations, including applicable connector, socket, cable, and PCB effects, with recommendations provided before package tape-out. • Leadership and qualifications: The position establishes SI guidelines and sign-off criteria, leads design reviews, works across distributed teams, and mentors junior engineers. Candidates need strong electromagnetic and transmission-line knowledge, advanced package SI experience, proficiency with tools such as Ansys HFSS, SIwave, Cadence Sigrity, Clarity 3D Solver, and Keysight ADS, plus expertise in SerDes analysis, PAM4 equalization, advanced substrates, and relevant interface specifications. A BS, MS, or PhD and 8–15+ years of relevant experience are required; preferred experience includes chiplets, silicon interposers, UCIe, 112G and 224G SerDes, 448G architectures,measurement correlation, power integrity interactions, and Python-based automation Applicants : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. kula:slice:64069.description: About the role : We run the production infrastructure behind a regulated, digital-first bank payment rails, core banking workloads, and customer-facing services on a multi-account AWS estate managed through code and GitOps. It's a place where reliability and trust matter deeply, and where the systems you look after have real consequences for real customers. We're looking for an SRE-1 who enjoys that kind of responsibility: someone who keeps systems stable, automates away the repetitive work, and brings a steady hand when things break. You'll make changes through well-defined, safe paths, debug production with curiosity, and treat reliability and compliance as part of the same craft rather than competing goals. This is a hands-on production role. You'll own real systems, share the on-call rotation with the team, and grow into the judgment that banking infrastructure rewards. What you will do: Operate and maintain production cloud infrastructure with a focus on availability, stability, and risk reduction. Make infrastructure and configuration changes through approved patterns and GitOps workflows, so changes stay reviewable, repeatable, and safe. Support Kubernetes-based production workloads across our environments: deployments, scaling, rollouts, and day-2 operations like debugging, recovery, and resource tuning. Monitor system health through metrics, logs, and alerts, and use them to find and fix the root of a problem. Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, and recovery for production systems. Contribute to root cause analysis and help implement the preventive actions that come out of post-incident reviews. Build automation for operational tasks (runbooks, scripts, Terraform) to reduce manual effort and free the team up for higher-value work. Help maintain the security, compliance, and governance controls that keep a regulated banking environment healthy. Take part in disaster recovery work DR drills, failover, cross-region posture as a meaningful part of what we deliver. Keep runbooks, SOPs, and operational documentation useful and up to date. Collaborate with DevEx and application teams to help their services land smoothly in production. What you will need: Must-Have Core engineering 1–3 years in SRE / Infrastructure / Production Operations roles. Hands-on AWS experience in production: core services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS/Aurora, load balancing) with genuine operational depth, and comfort working within a multi-account setup. Working knowledge of Kubernetes with day-2 experience you can debug a CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKill, failed rollout, or in-cluster DNS issue, not only deploy manifests. Strong Linux fundamentals with real troubleshooting depth you're comfortable reasoning through a hung process, disk or inode exhaustion, a failing systemd unit, or a tricky networking issue. Networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTPS/TLS, load balancing) solid enough to reason about latency and connectivity during a live incident. Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch), using it to form and test hypotheses when you debug. Hands-on Terraform and Git for infrastructure change, including writing reusable, scalable modules, with a good feel for plan/apply, state, and code review. Ability to write automation scripts (Bash required; Python strongly preferred). How you work You value safe, reviewable change. You're happy working through approved patterns and change windows, because you know that's what keeps a shared production environment trustworthy. You think in terms of GitOps Git as the source of truth and you're mindful of blast radius and keeping workloads well isolated. You're ready to share the on-call rotation, and you tend to stay calm and methodical when things get busy. You lean toward least-privilege and just-in-time access as a natural way of working, and you're comfortable with the audit trails that come with a bank. You see compliance (RBI, NPCI, PCI) as a set of guardrails to design within, and you're good at finding solutions that work well inside them. You treat documentation as part of the job updating runbooks and SOPs so the next person (often future-you) has an easier time. You use AI tooling well pairing it with your own engineering judgment rather than leaning on it blindly and you're mindful that tokens and compute have a cost, not something to take for granted. Good-to-Have Exposure to high-availability and disaster recovery setups (multi-AZ, cross-region replication, active-passive/active-active). Experience with web servers (nginx, Apache). Working knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, ElasticSearch etc.) enough to triage alongside our DBAs. Prior experience in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment (banking, fintech, payments). Multicloud exposure, especially with major cloud providers. Hands-on experience across a broader set of Terraform providers. Python or Go for building operational tooling. Life at slice: Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: Competitive salaries. Period. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place.
